clusters.pick_reason: #2600 fixes a superset of the problem: it settles parked JSON-mode POSTs on close() (like #2692) but additionally clears _requestToStreamMapping, which #2692's diff does not touch, closing a related leak where a send() suspended inside eventStore.storeEvent() across a close() can resume against a retired correlation and record an undeliverable response. #2600's changeset also explicitly calls out that both paths apply to NodeStreamableHTTPServerTransport, indicating broader test coverage of the wrapper. #2692 covers only the response-settling half of the same close() behavior.
